references.text: Moses received instructions to place the testimony (the tablets of the law) in the ark, which he here confirms that he has done.
The Lord commanded that the mercy seat should be placed over the ark with the testimony inside, which Moses here carries out.
Moses took the testimony and put it in the ark, set the poles on the ark, and placed the mercy seat on top.
The preceding context where the Lord commands Moses to carve new stone tablets and make an ark of wood.
Confirms that there was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets which Moses placed there at Horeb.
Parallel text in Chronicles which also confirms that only the two tablets were in the ark.
The book of Hebrews mentions the ark of the covenant containing the tablets of the law, and confirms the tradition of the tablets being in the ark.
